name: Flip and Flip Again
designNote: Aha: Sol and Lune line up again and again, flipping the Tarnish asleep and awake to slip past each one in turn. Only at the very end does Sol take the mirror shrine, so the last steps send them to opposite goals.
hints: You'll need to line up more than once.
Each time a Tarnish closes in, line up to put it to sleep. Save the mirror shrine for the end.
